parsed.answer: Combine GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/accounts (listCustomerAccounts) to get the accountId values, then GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/balances (getAccountBalances) to read the balances of one account.

Question: Which two endpoints do I combine to list a customer's accounts and then read the balances of one of them?

Searches already run:
1. list customer accounts endpoint
2. read account balance endpoint

Collected excerpts:

<excerpt id="customers-api:listCustomerAccounts:operation">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/accounts · operation
operationId: listCustomerAccounts
Summary: List the accounts of a customer
Description: Returns every account held by the customer, including blocked accounts. Use the accountId values with the Accounts and Statements APIs.
Tags: Customers
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: customers:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: customerId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="customers-api:listConsents:operation">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/consents · operation
operationId: listConsents
Summary: List consents
Description: Returns the consents a customer has granted, together with their purpose and expiry.
Tags: Consents
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: customers:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: customerId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:listTransactions:operation">
[accounts-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/transactions · operation
operationId: listTransactions
Summary: List transactions
Description: Returns the booked transactions of an account, newest first, optionally restricted to a date range. Results are paged with a cursor: pass the nextCursor of one page as the cursor of the next call.
Tags: Transactions
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: accounts:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: accountId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header), fromDate (query), toDate (query), cursor (query), limit (query)
Responses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

[statements-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/statements · operation
operationId: listStatements
Summary: List statements
Description: Returns the statements of an account for one calendar year. Statements are produced monthly, so a full year holds up to twelve entries.
Tags: Statements
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: statements:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: accountId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header), year (query)
Responses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:Account:component_schema">
[accounts-api] component schema Account
Schema Account: object
Description: Basic details of an account (version 1).
Required fields: accountId, customerId, iban, currency, productName, status
- accountId (string, required): Identifier of the account.
- customerId (string, required): Identifier of the customer who holds the account.
- iban (string, required): International bank account number.
- currency (string, required): ISO 4217 currency code of the account.
- productName (string, required): Name of the account product.
- status (string, enum OPEN|BLOCKED, required): Whether the account can be used.
- openedDate (string, format date, optional): Date the account was opened.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:Balances:component_schema">
[accounts-api] component schema Balances
Schema Balances: object
Description: The balances of an account at a point in time.
Required fields: accountId, bookedBalance, availableBalance, asOf
- accountId (string, required): Identifier of the account.
- bookedBalance (Amount, required)
- availableBalance (Amount, required)
- asOf (string, format date-time, required): Moment the balances were read.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:getAccountBalances:operation">
[accounts-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/balances · operation
operationId: getAccountBalances
Summary: Get account balances
Description: Returns the booked and the available balance of an account at the moment of the call.
Tags: Balances
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: accounts:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: accountId (path), X-Correlation-Id (header)
Responses: 200, 401, 403, 404, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:getAccountBalances:response:200">
[accounts-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/balances · response 200
Response 200: The current balances.
Headers:
- X-Correlation-Id (string): The correlation identifier of the call. It repeats the caller's value, or a generated one when none was sent.
Content application/json: Balances
- accountId (string, required): Identifier of the account.
- bookedBalance (Amount, required)
- availableBalance (Amount, required)
- asOf (string, format date-time, required): Moment the balances were read.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:bearerAuth:security_scheme">
[accounts-api] security scheme bearerAuth
Type: oauth2
Description: OAuth 2.0 access token obtained from the token endpoint with the client credentials grant. The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each operation lists the scope it needs.
Flow clientCredentials: token URL https://api.labbank.example/oauth/token

- scope customers:write: Change customer contact details.
- scope accounts:read: Read accounts, balances and transactions.
- scope statements:read: Read and request account statements.
- scope payments:write: Initiate, read and cancel payments.
</excerpt>
